title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction
title_zh: SWE-Journey：通过长周期、多轮交互，实现更真实的编码助手评估

paragraphs.en: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major application of LLM agents, yet existing benchmarks remain far from real-world use, particularly in task horizon and interaction length. Code assistants require completing long chains of development work in continuously evolving repositories, while repeatedly clarifying requirements and adapting implementations through multi-turn interaction. To address these gaps, we introduce SWE-Journey , a benchmark for more realistic evaluation of coding assistants. To address the task-horizon gap, we propose a weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline that automatically constructs long-horizon coding tasks. To address the interaction gap, we mine four representative user personas from real interaction data and build a user-simulation agent to reproduce realistic code-assistance interactions. On average, models pass over 75% of tests for requested functionality with software architects, but fewer than 25% with non-coders. These results show that current coding assistants still fall short of enabling reliable coding for non-coders. We further analyze the reasons for this gap and identify asking right, finding right, and fixing right as key capabilities during interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 像 Claude Code 和 Codex 这样的编码助手已成为 LLM 智能体的主要应用，但现有的基准测试仍远未能反映真实世界的使用场景，尤其是在任务时间跨度和交互长度方面。 编码助手需要在持续演变的代码库中完成一连串的开发工作，同时通过多轮交互反复澄清需求并调整实现方案。 为填补这些差距，我们提出了 SWE-Journey——一个用于更真实地评估编码助手的基准测试。 为了应对任务时间跨度方面的差距，我们提出了一种从弱到强的合成流程，能够自动构建长时间跨度的编码任务。 为了应对交互方面的差距，我们从真实交互数据中挖掘出四种典型用户角色，并构建了一个用户模拟智能体，以重现真实的编码辅助交互过程。 平均而言，在与软件架构师合作时，模型能通过超过 75% 的功能性测试；而在与非编码者合作时，这一比例则低于 25%。 这些结果表明，当前的编码助手仍未能实现让非编码者可靠地进行编码的目标。 我们进一步分析了造成这种差距的原因，并确定“正确提问”、“正确发现”和“正确修复”是交互过程中的关键能力。

paragraphs.en: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major real-world application of LLM agents ( Baumann et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Realistic evaluation of coding assistants, however, must capture two key characteristics. First, these tasks are often long-horizon: the engineering goals they address often require a substantial sequence of changes across files and modules, with later steps building on earlier ones ( Desai et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Baumann et al., 2026 ) . Second, user interaction is multi-turn: rather than providing a complete requirements document for an entire long-horizon engineering goal upfront, real users introduce requests incrementally, provide feedback, sometimes leave requirements underspecified, and revise their goals in response to intermediate results ( Hao et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) , with interaction patterns varying substantially across users and tasks ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Baumann et al., 2026 ) . A realistic evaluation must therefore capture both.
paragraphs.zh: 像 Claude Code 和 Codex 这样的编码助手已成为 LLM 智能体的重要现实应用（Baumann 等，2026；Yang 等，2024）。 然而，对编码助手的真实评估必须捕捉到两个关键特征。 首先，这些任务通常是长期任务：它们所解决的工程目标往往需要在多个文件和模块中进行大量连续更改，后续步骤会基于前面的步骤展开（Desai 等，2026；Shen 等，2026；Baumann 等，2026）。 其次，用户互动是多轮次的：真实用户不会一开始就提供整个长期工程目标的完整需求文档，而是逐步提出请求、提供反馈，有时甚至需求描述不完整，并根据中间结果调整目标（Hao 等，2024；Zhong 等，2025），且不同用户和任务的互动模式存在显著差异（Zhang 等，2025a；Baumann 等，2026）。 因此，一次真实的评估必须同时捕捉到这两个特征。

paragraphs.en: Yet existing benchmarks only partially cover these characteristics jointly. One line of work ( Deng et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025 ; Thai et al., 2025 ) increases task difficulty and extends execution horizons, requiring broader context and sustained interaction with the repository, but typically presents the complete instance upfront and therefore leaves incremental requirement disclosure and adaptation to user feedback untested. Another line ( Miao et al., 2025 ; Orlanski et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) introduces multi-turn interaction through evolving requests, adaptive feedback, or simulated users, but often uses shorter interaction sequences and coarser user models than those needed to represent coding-assistant collaboration. As Figure 1 illustrates, prior work covers different portions of this design space, while the joint evaluation of long-horizon, stateful repository development and realistic multi-turn interaction remains underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的基准测试仅部分涵盖了这些特征的联合评估。 一类研究（Deng 等人，2025b；Li 等人，2025；Thai 等人，2025）通过增加任务难度和延长执行时间范围，要求更广泛的情境信息和与代码库的持续交互，但通常会将完整实例一次性呈现，因此未能测试逐步披露需求并根据用户反馈进行调整的能力。 另一类研究（Miao 等人，2025；Orlanski 等人，2026；Zhou 等人，2025）通过不断变化的请求、自适应反馈或模拟用户引入了多轮交互，但所使用的交互序列通常较短，对用户模型的刻画也较粗略，不足以真实反映编码助手协作的实际需求。 如图 1 所示，先前的研究仅覆盖了该设计空间的不同部分，而对长期状态保持的库开发以及真实多轮交互的联合评估仍缺乏充分探索。

paragraphs.en: To close this gap, we introduce SWE-Journey for long-horizon, multi-turn evaluation of coding assistants . Rather than simply combining prior advances along the two axes, we address the additional challenges of constructing long-horizon tasks and simulating realistic multi-turn interactions, advancing both through an automated pipeline tailored to coding assistants. For task construction, rather than relying on costly expert annotation ( Miao et al., 2025 ) or mining public repository histories with potential data leakage risks ( Thai et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , we introduce a scalable weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline. Through subtask decomposition and iterative expansion, it produces sufficiently long and challenging tasks while generating new follow-up requirements beyond the public seed, thereby reducing direct solution leakage. For multi-turn interaction, we mine four recurring user personas from real interaction data and build a persona-conditioned user-simulation agent that captures common user behaviors in coding-assistant interactions. This grounds interactions in observed user behavior while covering diverse interaction styles, enabling us to analyze where current coding assistants fall short. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 SWE-Journey，用于对编码助手进行长期、多轮次的评估。 我们并未简单地将此前沿两个方向的进展相结合，而是解决了构建长期任务以及模拟真实多轮次交互所面临的额外挑战，并通过专为编码助手设计的自动化流程推动了这两方面的进步。 在任务构建方面，我们并未依赖成本高昂的专家标注（Miao et al., 2025），也未采用可能引发数据泄露风险的公共仓库历史数据挖掘方法（Thai et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2026），而是提出了一种可扩展的弱到强合成流程。 通过子任务分解与迭代扩展，该流程能够生成足够长且富有挑战性的任务，同时基于公开种子数据生成新的后续需求，从而减少直接解决方案的泄露。 在多轮次交互方面，我们从真实交互数据中挖掘出四种常见的用户角色，并构建了一个以角色为条件的用户模拟智能体，用以捕捉编码助手交互中的典型用户行为。 这种方法使交互能够基于观察到的用户行为展开，同时覆盖多样化的交互风格，从而让我们能够分析当前编码助手的不足所在。 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: Early repository-level benchmarks largely focus on single-turn, issue-level evaluation. SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and SWE-bench Verified evaluate real GitHub issue resolution, while later extensions incorporate screenshots and visual information ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , broader language and engineering coverage ( Zan et al., 2025 ; Rashid et al., 2025 ) , performance optimization ( He et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) , repository exploration ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and code question answering ( Peng et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . These benchmarks, however, typically provide the task upfront. More interactive settings include scripted or progressively revealed rounds ( Shastry et al., 2026 ; Orlanski et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , adaptive human feedback ( Miao et al., 2025 ) , and reactive or simulated users for goal discovery, clarification, and correction ( King and Flanigan, 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Raghavendra et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的仓库级基准测试主要关注单轮、问题级别的评估。 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）和 SWE-bench Verified 评估真实的 GitHub 问题解决过程，而后续扩展则纳入了截图和视觉信息（Yang 等人，2025a）、更广泛的语言和工程覆盖范围（Zan 等人，2025；Rashid 等人，2025）、性能优化（He 等人，2025；Ma 等人，2025）、仓库探索（Zhang 等人，2026a）以及代码问答（Peng 等人，2026a；Cai 等人，2026）。 然而，这些基准测试通常会在任务开始时直接提供任务说明。 更具互动性的设置包括脚本化或逐步揭示的回合（Shastry 等人，2026；Orlanski 等人，2026；Shen 等人，2026）、自适应的人类反馈（Miao 等人，2025），以及用于目标发现、澄清和纠正的反应式或模拟用户（King 和 Flanigan，2026；Wu 等人，2026；Raghavendra 等人，2026；Zhou 等人，2025）。

sents.en: Early repository-level benchmarks largely focus on single-turn, issue-level evaluation.
sents.zh: 早期的仓库级基准测试主要关注单轮、问题级别的评估。

sents.en: SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and SWE-bench Verified evaluate real GitHub issue resolution, while later extensions incorporate screenshots and visual information ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , broader language and engineering coverage ( Zan et al., 2025 ; Rashid et al., 2025 ) , performance optimization ( He et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) , repository exploration ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and code question answering ( Peng et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: These benchmarks, however, typically provide the task upfront.

sents.en: More interactive settings include scripted or progressively revealed rounds ( Shastry et al., 2026 ; Orlanski et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , adaptive human feedback ( Miao et al., 2025 ) , and reactive or simulated users for goal discovery, clarification, and correction ( King and Flanigan, 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Raghavendra et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 更具互动性的设置包括脚本化或逐步揭示的回合（Shastry 等人，2026；Orlanski 等人，2026；Shen 等人，2026）、自适应的人类反馈（Miao 等人，2025），以及用于目标发现、澄清和纠正的反应式或模拟用户（King 和 Flanigan，2026；Wu 等人，2026；Raghavendra 等人，2026；Zhou 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: However, existing benchmarks still lack a coding-assistance-specific taxonomy of persona definitions and sufficiently long interaction horizons. We address this by mining real interactions to define four representative personas and by synthesizing long-horizon tasks that elicit more interaction turns.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的基准测试仍然缺乏针对代码辅助功能的人格定义的专门分类体系，以及足够长的交互时间跨度。 我们通过挖掘真实交互来定义四种代表性人格，并合成需要更多交互轮次的长时程任务来解决这一问题。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work extends the task-horizon axis. At the feature level, benchmarks progress from localized issue fixing to repository-level feature implementation ( Li et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , natural-language-driven feature development ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025a ) , and reasoning-augmented feature addition ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025b ) increases task size, breadth, and sustained difficulty. SWE-EVO ( Thai et al., 2025 ) and RoadmapBench ( Xu et al., 2026 ) construct longer trajectories around software evolution and version upgrades. ChainSWE evaluates sequential bug fixing, while SWE-Chain ( Lam et al., 2026 ) and SWE-CI ( Chen et al., 2026 ) study chained releases and regression risks under persistent repository state. At the project scale, Zhao et al. (2025) and Ding et al. (2025) build libraries or repositories from specifications; MirrorCode ( Adamczewski et al., 2026 ) evaluates full-program reimplementation from behavioral access; and SWE-Marathon ( Desai et al., 2026 ) targets ultra-long-horizon implementation, optimization, and research workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 一项互补的研究方向扩展了任务视野轴。 在功能层面，基准测试从局部问题修复逐步发展到仓库级别的功能实现（Li et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2026）、自然语言驱动的功能开发（Chen et al., 2025；Deng et al., 2025a），以及增强推理能力的功能添加（Liu et al., 2026）。 SWE-bench Pro（Deng et al., 2025b）提升了任务的规模、广度和持续难度。 SWE-EVO（Thai et al., 2025）和 RoadmapBench（Xu et al., 2026）围绕软件演化和版本升级构建了更长的轨迹。 ChainSWE 评估了顺序性错误修复，而 SWE-Chain（Lam et al., 2026）和 SWE-CI（Chen et al., 2026）则研究了在仓库状态持续变化下的连锁发布和回归风险。 在项目规模上，Zhao et al.（2025）和 Ding et al. （2025）根据规格说明构建库或仓库；MirrorCode（Adamczewski et al., 2026）评估了基于行为访问的完整程序重新实现；而 SWE-Marathon（Desai et al., 2026）则针对超长期限的实现、优化和研究任务。

paragraphs.en: However, constructing such tasks remains challenging. Mining GitHub history enables answer-seeking retrieval: with only a bash tool, a strong model can locate newer repository versions online. In practice, constructing long-horizon coding tasks from scratch typically requires substantial expert involvement, making it expensive and difficult to scale. Even manually labeling a short SWE-Bench-style instance is estimated to cost approximately $100 per instance ( Oliva et al., 2025 ) , let alone constructing one from scratch. We therefore develop a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing long-horizon coding tasks at lower cost while reducing leakage risk. See Appendix A.1 for more related work on data synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，构建此类任务仍然具有挑战性。 挖掘 GitHub 历史可以实现答案导向的检索：仅借助一个 bash 工具，强大的模型就能在线定位更新版本的代码库。 在实践中，从头构建长期编码任务通常需要大量专家的参与，因此成本高昂且难以扩展。 即使手动标注一个简短的 SWE-Bench 风格实例，据估计每个实例的成本也约为 100 美元（Oliva 等人，2025），更不用说从头构建一个了。 因此，我们开发了一套完全自动化的流程，以较低成本合成长期编码任务，同时减少数据泄露的风险。 更多有关数据合成的相关研究，请参见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-Journey to enable more realistic evaluation of coding assistants by addressing two major gaps in existing benchmarks: long-horizon tasks (Figure 2 (A)) and multi-turn interaction (Figure 2 (B, C)). We first describe the design principles guiding the method.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SWE-Journey，旨在通过解决现有基准测试中的两个主要缺陷——长期任务（图 2 (A)）和多轮交互（图 2 (B, C)），实现对编码助手的更逼真评估。 我们首先介绍指导该方法的设计原则。

sents.en: We introduce SWE-Journey to enable more realistic evaluation of coding assistants by addressing two major gaps in existing benchmarks: long-horizon tasks (Figure 2 (A)) and multi-turn interaction (Figure 2 (B, C)).
sents.zh: 我们提出 SWE-Journey，旨在通过解决现有基准测试中的两个主要缺陷——长期任务（图 2 (A)）和多轮交互（图 2 (B, C)），实现对编码助手的更逼真评估。

sents.en: We first describe the design principles guiding the method.
sents.zh: 我们首先介绍指导该方法的设计原则。

paragraphs.en: One challenge is constructing sufficiently challenging long-horizon tasks. We use automated data synthesis to generate a long sequence of follow-up requirements rather than directly reusing public issues, reducing data-leakage risk and lowering the cost from the roughly $100 required to only label a short task manually ( Oliva et al., 2025 ) to $56.64 for synthesizing a long-horizon task from scratch. However, a synthesis model may struggle to generate tasks beyond its own capabilities. We therefore adopt a weak-to-strong strategy: decomposing long-horizon synthesis into smaller subtasks, separately synthesizing each subtask’s components, and accumulating a reusable module-level skills library. These operations reduce the difficulty of each step and form the task-generation loop described in § 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 一个挑战是构建具有足够难度的长期任务。 我们使用自动化数据合成来生成一系列连续的后续需求，而不是直接复用公开的问题，从而降低了数据泄露的风险，并将成本从手动标注短任务所需的约 100 美元（Oliva et al., 2025）降至从头合成长期任务所需的 56.64 美元。 然而，合成模型可能难以生成超出其自身能力的任务。 因此，我们采用了一种“弱到强”的策略：将长期任务的合成分解为更小的子任务，分别合成每个子任务的组成部分，并积累一个可重用的模块级技能库。 这些操作降低了每一步的难度，并形成了 §3.2 中描述的任務生成循环。

sents.zh: 一个挑战是构建具有足够难度的长期任务。

paragraphs.en: Simulating task completion through interaction for coding-assistant tasks is another challenge because the product serves a broad user base with different interaction styles. We operationalize this variation by extracting five persona dimensions and their taxonomy through data analysis of real interaction logs, yielding four representative personas. An LLM agent then simulates persona-consistent users, using two environment tools, two progress states, and a rubric to guide the interaction, as detailed in § 3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过交互模拟任务完成过程是编码助手任务中的另一项挑战，因为该产品服务于具有不同交互风格的广泛用户群体。 我们通过分析真实交互日志数据，提取出五个角色维度及其分类体系，从而将这种差异具体化，并得到了四个代表性角色。 随后，一个 LLM 智能体模拟与角色一致的用户，借助两种环境工具、两种进度状态和一份评分标准来引导交互，具体细节见 § 3.3。

sents.en: Simulating task completion through interaction for coding-assistant tasks is another challenge because the product serves a broad user base with different interaction styles.
sents.zh: 通过交互模拟任务完成过程是编码助手任务中的另一项挑战，因为该产品服务于具有不同交互风格的广泛用户群体。

sents.zh: 随后，一个 LLM 智能体模拟与角色一致的用户，借助两种环境工具、两种进度状态和一份评分标准来引导交互，具体细节见 § 3.3。

paragraphs.en: Traditional coding benchmarks ask the model to generate a patch and test its correctness offline, omitting two properties of coding-assistant use: (1) an assistant operates on the user’s actual working directory and should avoid destructive operations or substantial environmental changes; and (2) tasks may be sequential, with the same module repeatedly modified to achieve a larger goal. We therefore evaluate execution online to better match coding-assistant use, with a user-simulation agent, coding-assistant agent, and testing performed online in sequence, as detailed in § 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 传统的编码基准测试要求模型生成一个代码补丁，并在离线环境中测试其正确性，但忽略了编码助手使用的两个特性：（1）助手是在用户的实际工作目录中操作的，因此应避免破坏性操作或对环境造成重大改变；（2）任务可能是顺序执行的，即为了达成更大的目标而反复修改同一个模块。 因此，我们通过在线执行来更贴近编码助手的实际使用场景，具体流程包括：用户模拟智能体、编码助手智能体以及在线测试依次执行，详见 § 3.4。

sents.zh: 因此，我们通过在线执行来更贴近编码助手的实际使用场景，具体流程包括：用户模拟智能体、编码助手智能体以及在线测试依次执行，详见 § 3.4。

paragraphs.en: Following the principles above, we adopt a weak-to-strong strategy: a weak synthesis model constructs a final long-horizon task whose full requirements exceed the model’s capabilities. As shown in the task-generation loop of Figure 2 (A), the loop has three components.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循上述原则，我们采用一种从弱到强的策略：一个较弱的合成模型会构建一个最终长期任务，其全部要求超出该模型的能力范围。 如图 2（A）中的任务生成循环所示，该循环包含三个组成部分。

sents.en: Following the principles above, we adopt a weak-to-strong strategy: a weak synthesis model constructs a final long-horizon task whose full requirements exceed the model’s capabilities.
sents.zh: 遵循上述原则，我们采用一种从弱到强的策略：一个较弱的合成模型会构建一个最终长期任务，其全部要求超出该模型的能力范围。

sents.en: As shown in the task-generation loop of Figure 2 (A), the loop has three components.
sents.zh: 如图 2（A）中的任务生成循环所示，该循环包含三个组成部分。

paragraphs.en: To further distribute the difficulty of task construction, we first use a stronger model to plan the long-horizon task and then use a relatively weaker model to implement the plan. Specifically, we start from an existing repository and its environment and ask Claude Opus 4.8 ( Desai et al., 2026 ) to generate a high-level task blueprint and its subtasks, making them as close as possible to realistic software-engineering needs. To this end, we provide a bash tool so that the model can run commands in the Docker container and understand the repository state, ensuring that the task is authentic and executable. We then introduce two input variables to ensure diversity: (1) a seed task, prompting the model to generate related tasks; and (2) a new task angle, prompting it to expand the seed task from that angle. We also require the generated task to exceed the seed task on at least two of four dimensions—context scope, change scope, requirement depth, and knowledge breadth—to avoid homogeneous outputs. Appendix A.2 details the taxonomy construction procedure and definitions of these four dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步分散任务构建的难度，我们首先使用一个更强的模型来规划长期任务，然后使用一个相对较弱的模型来实现该计划。 具体来说，我们从现有的代码库及其环境出发，要求 Claude Opus 4.8（Desai et al., 2026）生成一个高层任务蓝图及其子任务，使其尽可能贴近真实的软件工程需求。 为此，我们提供了一个 bash 工具，使模型能够在 Docker 容器中运行命令并理解代码库的状态，从而确保任务的真实性和可执行性。 接着，我们引入两个输入变量以确保多样性：（1）一个种子任务，用于提示模型生成相关任务；以及（2）一个新的任务角度，用于提示模型从该角度扩展种子任务。 我们还要求生成的任务在四个维度中至少有两个维度上超越种子任务——上下文范围、变更范围、需求深度和知识广度——以避免输出同质化。 附录 A.2 详细说明了分类体系构建的流程以及这四个维度的定义。

sents.en: To further distribute the difficulty of task construction, we first use a stronger model to plan the long-horizon task and then use a relatively weaker model to implement the plan.
sents.zh: 为了进一步分散任务构建的难度，我们首先使用一个更强的模型来规划长期任务，然后使用一个相对较弱的模型来实现该计划。

sents.en: Specifically, we start from an existing repository and its environment and ask Claude Opus 4.8 ( Desai et al., 2026 ) to generate a high-level task blueprint and its subtasks, making them as close as possible to realistic software-engineering needs.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们从现有的代码库及其环境出发，要求 Claude Opus 4.8（Desai et al., 2026）生成一个高层任务蓝图及其子任务，使其尽可能贴近真实的软件工程需求。

sents.en: To this end, we provide a bash tool so that the model can run commands in the Docker container and understand the repository state, ensuring that the task is authentic and executable.
sents.zh: 为此，我们提供了一个 bash 工具，使模型能够在 Docker 容器中运行命令并理解代码库的状态，从而确保任务的真实性和可执行性。

sents.en: We then introduce two input variables to ensure diversity: (1) a seed task, prompting the model to generate related tasks; and (2) a new task angle, prompting it to expand the seed task from that angle.
sents.zh: 接着，我们引入两个输入变量以确保多样性：（1）一个种子任务，用于提示模型生成相关任务；以及（2）一个新的任务角度，用于提示模型从该角度扩展种子任务。

sents.en: We also require the generated task to exceed the seed task on at least two of four dimensions—context scope, change scope, requirement depth, and knowledge breadth—to avoid homogeneous outputs.
sents.zh: 我们还要求生成的任务在四个维度中至少有两个维度上超越种子任务——上下文范围、变更范围、需求深度和知识广度——以避免输出同质化。

sents.en: Appendix A.2 details the taxonomy construction procedure and definitions of these four dimensions.
sents.zh: 附录 A.2 详细说明了分类体系构建的流程以及这四个维度的定义。

paragraphs.en: Next, for each subtask in the plan, we use the relatively weaker model, GLM-5.2 ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , to implement it in code through a three-step loop, with each subtask building on the preceding code state. Step-request generation : following the plan-first strategy, we first construct a user query and natural-language acceptance criteria. The query serves as a blueprint for the problem to be solved, while the criteria serve as a blueprint for execution-based verification. Patch-and-F2P generation : guided by these, we generate a reference patch and Fail-to-Pass (F2P) tests—the reference patch realizes the query in code, and the F2P tests fail on the original code but pass after the patch, verifying in executable form whether a model-generated patch meets the criteria. P2P generation : since long-horizon tasks must show not only that new behavior is added but also that existing behavior is not broken, we further generate Pass-to-Pass (P2P) tests, which pass on both the original and patched code and detect unintended regressions. Throughout, besides the bash tool, we provide a reset tool that lets the model restore the worktree and check whether the current patch takes effect and passes the tests, thereby improving the success rate of task generation.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，对于计划中的每个子任务，我们使用相对较弱的模型 GLM-5.2（Zhang 等人，2025b）通过一个三步循环将其实现为代码，其中每个子任务都基于前一步的代码状态进行构建。 步骤请求生成：遵循“先计划”策略，我们首先构建一个用户查询和自然语言形式的验收标准。 该查询作为待解决问题蓝图的依据，而验收标准则作为执行验证蓝图的依据。 Patch-and-F2P 生成：在这些指导下，我们生成一个参考补丁和“失败到通过”（F2P）测试——参考补丁将查询转化为代码实现，而 F2P 测试在原始代码上会失败，但在应用补丁后通过，从而以可执行形式验证模型生成的补丁是否符合验收标准。 P2P 生成：由于长期任务不仅需要展示新行为的添加，还需要确保现有行为未被破坏，因此我们进一步生成“通过到通过”（P2P）测试——这些测试在原始代码和补丁后的代码上都能通过，并能检测出非预期的回归问题。 在整个过程中，除了 bash 工具外，我们还提供了一个重置工具，允许模型恢复工作树并检查当前补丁是否生效且通过测试，从而提升任务生成的成功率。

paragraphs.en: The procedure above can complete all subtasks step by step, producing both the textual description and code implementation of a complete plan stage. A single stage, however, does not guarantee a task that is both sufficiently long and difficult. We therefore iterate, using the previous round’s task as the seed for the next plan stage and again increasing difficulty along at least two of the four dimensions in each round. We construct a total of three progressively harder plan stages to synthesize a sufficiently difficult task.
paragraphs.zh: 上述流程可以逐步完成所有子任务，生成完整计划阶段的文本描述和代码实现。 然而，单个阶段并不能保证生成的任务既足够长又具有足够的难度。 因此，我们采用迭代方式：将上一轮的任务作为下一轮计划阶段的种子，并在每一轮中至少从四个维度中的两个提升难度。 我们总共构建三个逐步加难的计划阶段，以合成一个难度足够的任务。

paragraphs.en: To ensure task quality, we use runtime rubrics to assess whether the synthesized data is correct both semantically and in code execution. Specifically, we use two complementary signals. For rubric-based verification, a separate model, GPT-5.4 ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , scores plan generation against a task-authenticity rubric (realistic motivation, clear task boundaries, no oracle information) and scores the Patch-and-F2P stage for semantic alignment among the request, acceptance criteria, and tests. Execution-based verification requires F2P tests to fail before the patch and pass afterward, and P2P tests to pass both before and after. On any failure, the model retries the current step with failure feedback until the attempt limit; if exceeded, the workflow returns to planning, since the fault may lie in an infeasible plan rather than the implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保任务质量，我们使用运行时评分标准来评估所合成的数据在语义和代码执行方面是否正确。 具体来说，我们使用了两种互补的信号。 对于基于评分标准的验证，一个独立的模型 GPT-5.4（Lee 等人，2025）会根据任务真实性评分标准（现实动机、明确的任务边界、无先知信息）对计划生成进行评分，并对 Patch-and-F2P 阶段在请求、验收标准和测试之间的语义一致性进行评分。 基于执行的验证要求 F2P 测试在打补丁前失败，打补丁后通过；而 P2P 测试则要求在打补丁前后均通过。 一旦出现任何失败，模型会结合失败反馈重试当前步骤，直到达到尝试次数上限；若超出上限，工作流将返回规划阶段，因为问题可能出在不可行的计划上，而非实现过程。

paragraphs.en: Based on the synthesized long-horizon tasks, we use a user-simulation agent to realize online multi-turn interaction and build trajectories resembling challenging code-assistance tasks. The simulation agent acts as the user, while the coding assistant under evaluation performs the coding tasks and interacts with it online. Figure 2 (B, C) summarizes how we mine a persona taxonomy from real logs and derive the four representative personas driving this simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于合成的长期任务，我们使用一个用户模拟智能体来实现在线多轮交互，并构建类似于具有挑战性的代码辅助任务的轨迹。 模拟智能体充当用户角色，而被评估的编码助手则执行编码任务并与之进行在线交互。 图 2（B、C）总结了我们从真实日志中挖掘人物分类体系，并推导出驱动此次模拟的四种代表性人物的过程。

sents.zh: 图 2（B、C）总结了我们从真实日志中挖掘人物分类体系，并推导出驱动此次模拟的四种代表性人物的过程。

paragraphs.en: Since users of coding assistants are diverse and complex, with substantially different interaction habits, simply prompting an LLM to simulate them is insufficient; their styles must be specified in detail for code-assistance scenarios. To build a comprehensive taxonomy, we start from real usage data in SWE-Chat ( Baumann et al., 2026 ) , an open-source collection of Claude Code interaction trajectories, and mine the dimensions and categories that coding-assistant user personas should cover. We perform this taxonomy mining in two stages over the large-scale dataset. First, we ask GPT 5.4 to generate short labels describing each trajectory’s interaction style. We then cluster them using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small embeddings and capacity-constrained k k -means to form balanced semantic clusters. Within each cluster, GPT 5.4 deduplicates near-identical labels and abstracts them into stable intermediate categories, yielding a clean global taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 由于编程辅助工具的用户群体多样且复杂，其交互习惯存在显著差异，因此仅通过提示大型语言模型（LLM）来模拟这些用户是不够的；在代码辅助场景下，必须对用户的风格进行详细指定。 为了构建一个全面的分类体系，我们从 SWE-Chat（Baumann 等人，2026）中的真实使用数据出发——这是一个包含 Claude Code 交互轨迹的开源数据集，并从中挖掘出编程辅助工具用户角色应涵盖的维度和类别。 我们在该大规模数据集上分两个阶段执行这一分类体系的挖掘工作。 首先，我们让 GPT 5.4 生成简短的标签，用以描述每条轨迹的交互风格。 接着，我们使用 OpenAI 的 text-embedding-3-small 嵌入模型和容量受限的 k-k-means 算法对这些标签进行聚类，从而形成均衡的语义簇。 在每个簇内，GPT 5.4 会去除几乎相同的重复标签，并将其抽象为稳定的中间类别，最终形成一个清晰的全局分类体系。

paragraphs.en: However, these categories may span multiple dimensions and are therefore often not mutually exclusive. To address this, we use GPT Deep Research to extract the dimensions, balancing broad coverage against redundancy. We then apply human feedback to resolve ambiguities and remove redundant coverage among the dimensions and their categories, yielding five persona dimensions: User Expertise, Detail Preference, Control Style, Goal Stability, and Verification Style.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些类别可能跨越多个维度，因此通常并非互斥的。 为了解决这个问题，我们使用 GPT Deep Research 提取各个维度，在广泛覆盖与冗余之间取得平衡。 接着，我们通过人类反馈来解决模糊之处，并消除各维度及其类别之间的冗余覆盖，最终得出五个角色维度：用户专业知识、细节偏好、控制风格、目标稳定性以及验证风格。

paragraphs.en: Since exhaustive evaluation over all persona combinations is infeasible, we select a small set of representative types to cover users with different programming expertise. We use the User Expertise dimension to divide users into four groups, then analyze SWE-Chat to identify, for each group, which categories in the other four persona dimensions occur more often than the population average and use those categories as the group’s representative settings. This yields four representative groups: Non-coders, Product Managers, New Developers, and Software Architects. Definitions of the five persona dimensions and their corresponding taxonomy, together with statistics and definitions for the four representative personas, are provided in Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于对所有角色组合进行全面评估并不可行，我们选择一组小型的代表性类型，以覆盖具有不同编程专业水平的用户。 我们使用“用户专业水平”这一维度将用户分为四组，然后分析 SWE-Chat，针对每组用户确定其他四个角色维度中哪些类别的出现频率高于总体平均水平，并将这些类别作为该组的代表性设置。 由此得出四个代表性群体：非编码者、产品经理、新开发人员和软件架构师。 五个角色维度的定义及其对应的分类体系，以及四个代表性角色的统计数据和定义，均列于附录 A.3 中。

paragraphs.en: In complex coding-assistant tasks, simulating the user is itself a difficult task. We therefore use a GLM-5.2 coding agent equipped with two tools for understanding the current environment: a bash tool for inspecting the repository and an evaluation tool for checking whether current changes pass subtask tests without regressions. Two states track its internal view of progress. The first is a per-subtask pending/done/failed status, which the simulator sets and reads according to the persona’s subjective judgment; it represents whether the user believes the task is complete or has failed and whether to continue assigning other tasks. The second is a User Confidence score updated each round: higher confidence loosens control and increases trust, whereas lower confidence makes the user more skeptical and less favorable; reaching zero ends the session, corresponding to the user switching to another product or model. We additionally introduce a rubric to drive a scoring-feedback-retry loop: an independent verifier scores each candidate message on language naturalness, absence of oracle information, disclosure pacing, Context Coherence, clarification closure, interaction granularity, and role-boundary clarity; messages that fail are rewritten using the verifier’s feedback. We also add a fixed extra reflection round to rewrite any message inconsistent with the current persona.
paragraphs.zh: 在复杂的编码助手任务中，模拟用户本身就是一个难题。 因此，我们使用一个配备两种工具的 GLM-5.2 编码智能体来理解当前环境：一种用于检查仓库的 bash 工具，以及一种用于验证当前更改是否通过子任务测试且未出现退化的评估工具。 两个状态用于追踪其内部对进展的看法。 第一个是每种子任务的“待处理/完成/失败”状态，由模拟器根据角色的主观判断进行设置和读取；它反映了用户是否认为任务已完成或失败，以及是否应继续分配其他任务。 第二个是每轮更新的用户信心分数：信心越高，控制越宽松，信任度也越高；而信心越低，用户则越怀疑且态度越不友好；当分数降至零时，会话将结束，对应于用户转向其他产品或模型。 我们还引入了一套评分标准，以驱动“评分-反馈-重试”循环：一个独立验证器会对每条候选消息的语言自然性、是否包含先知信息、披露节奏、上下文连贯性、澄清闭合性、互动颗粒度和角色边界清晰度进行评分；未通过的消息将根据验证器的反馈重新撰写。 此外，我们还增加了一个固定的额外反思轮次，以重新撰写任何与当前角色不一致的消息。

sents.en: In complex coding-assistant tasks, simulating the user is itself a difficult task.
sents.zh: 在复杂的编码助手任务中，模拟用户本身就是一个难题。

sents.en: We therefore use a GLM-5.2 coding agent equipped with two tools for understanding the current environment: a bash tool for inspecting the repository and an evaluation tool for checking whether current changes pass subtask tests without regressions.
sents.zh: 因此，我们使用一个配备两种工具的 GLM-5.2 编码智能体来理解当前环境：一种用于检查仓库的 bash 工具，以及一种用于验证当前更改是否通过子任务测试且未出现退化的评估工具。

sents.en: Two states track its internal view of progress.
sents.zh: 两个状态用于追踪其内部对进展的看法。

sents.en: The first is a per-subtask pending/done/failed status, which the simulator sets and reads according to the persona’s subjective judgment; it represents whether the user believes the task is complete or has failed and whether to continue assigning other tasks.
sents.zh: 第一个是每种子任务的“待处理/完成/失败”状态，由模拟器根据角色的主观判断进行设置和读取；它反映了用户是否认为任务已完成或失败，以及是否应继续分配其他任务。

sents.en: The second is a User Confidence score updated each round: higher confidence loosens control and increases trust, whereas lower confidence makes the user more skeptical and less favorable; reaching zero ends the session, corresponding to the user switching to another product or model.
sents.zh: 第二个是每轮更新的用户信心分数：信心越高，控制越宽松，信任度也越高；而信心越低，用户则越怀疑且态度越不友好；当分数降至零时，会话将结束，对应于用户转向其他产品或模型。

sents.en: We additionally introduce a rubric to drive a scoring-feedback-retry loop: an independent verifier scores each candidate message on language naturalness, absence of oracle information, disclosure pacing, Context Coherence, clarification closure, interaction granularity, and role-boundary clarity; messages that fail are rewritten using the verifier’s feedback.
sents.zh: 我们还引入了一套评分标准，以驱动“评分-反馈-重试”循环：一个独立验证器会对每条候选消息的语言自然性、是否包含先知信息、披露节奏、上下文连贯性、澄清闭合性、互动颗粒度和角色边界清晰度进行评分；未通过的消息将根据验证器的反馈重新撰写。

sents.en: We also add a fixed extra reflection round to rewrite any message inconsistent with the current persona.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还增加了一个固定的额外反思轮次，以重新撰写任何与当前角色不一致的消息。

paragraphs.en: After these two steps, we feed each synthesized long-horizon task to a user-simulation agent and let it alternate with the coding assistant inside the same Docker container, yielding interactions that approximate real coding-assistant scenarios. Appendix C.1 provides two complete Non-coder conversations on the Matplotlib task in Figure 2 (A), illustrating how requests, corrections, and acceptance develop across turns. However, we also need to investigate how to execute tests dynamically: tests should run both during task execution and after all tasks are complete, allowing us to determine whether the current environment implements the intended functionality.
paragraphs.zh: 经过这两个步骤后，我们将每个合成出的长期任务输入一个用户模拟智能体，并让它在同一个 Docker 容器中与编码助手交替运行，从而产生近似真实编码助手场景的交互。 附录 C.1 提供了关于图 2（A）中 Matplotlib 任务的两次完整的非编码者对话，展示了请求、修正和接受如何在不同回合中逐步展开。 然而，我们还需要研究如何动态执行测试：测试既应在任务执行期间运行，也应在所有任务完成后运行，以便判断当前环境是否实现了预期的功能。

sents.en: After these two steps, we feed each synthesized long-horizon task to a user-simulation agent and let it alternate with the coding assistant inside the same Docker container, yielding interactions that approximate real coding-assistant scenarios.
sents.zh: 经过这两个步骤后，我们将每个合成出的长期任务输入一个用户模拟智能体，并让它在同一个 Docker 容器中与编码助手交替运行，从而产生近似真实编码助手场景的交互。

sents.en: Appendix C.1 provides two complete Non-coder conversations on the Matplotlib task in Figure 2 (A), illustrating how requests, corrections, and acceptance develop across turns.

sents.en: However, we also need to investigate how to execute tests dynamically: tests should run both during task execution and after all tasks are complete, allowing us to determine whether the current environment implements the intended functionality.
sents.zh: 然而，我们还需要研究如何动态执行测试：测试既应在任务执行期间运行，也应在所有任务完成后运行，以便判断当前环境是否实现了预期的功能。

paragraphs.en: Conventional evaluation of coding assistants asks the model to submit a patch as its final answer, which is misaligned with code assistance: an interactive, online workflow in which the model modifies the environment and the user tests in real time. To emulate this, the model operates in a single persistent Docker container throughout; at test time, we directly check whether the current container state passes the tests and record all operations. Whenever the user considers a subtask in a plan stage fully complete, we run that plan’s tests to check whether the user has been deceived into believing the task is done. At session end, we run the full test suite again to ensure that earlier fixes have not regressed under later changes.
paragraphs.zh: 传统上对编码辅助工具的评估要求模型提交一个补丁作为最终答案，但这与代码辅助的实际流程并不一致：后者是一种交互式在线工作流程，模型在其中修改环境，而用户则实时进行测试。 为了模拟这一过程，模型在整个过程中都在一个持续运行的 Docker 容器中操作；在测试阶段，我们直接检查当前容器的状态是否通过测试，并记录所有操作。 每当用户认为计划阶段中的某个子任务已完全完成时，我们会运行该计划的测试，以检查用户是否被误导而误以为任务已完成。 在会话结束时，我们会再次运行完整的测试套件，以确保早期的修复并未因后续改动而出现退化。

sents.zh: 传统上对编码辅助工具的评估要求模型提交一个补丁作为最终答案，但这与代码辅助的实际流程并不一致：后者是一种交互式在线工作流程，模型在其中修改环境，而用户则实时进行测试。

sents.zh: 为了模拟这一过程，模型在整个过程中都在一个持续运行的 Docker 容器中操作；在测试阶段，我们直接检查当前容器的状态是否通过测试，并记录所有操作。

sents.en: Whenever the user considers a subtask in a plan stage fully complete, we run that plan’s tests to check whether the user has been deceived into believing the task is done.
sents.zh: 每当用户认为计划阶段中的某个子任务已完全完成时，我们会运行该计划的测试，以检查用户是否被误导而误以为任务已完成。

sents.en: At session end, we run the full test suite again to ensure that earlier fixes have not regressed under later changes.
sents.zh: 在会话结束时，我们会再次运行完整的测试套件，以确保早期的修复并未因后续改动而出现退化。

paragraphs.en: The Fail-to-Pass rate (F2P) counts test nodes that previously failed and pass after the coding assistant’s edits, measuring how well the model completes the required functionality; the Pass-to-Pass rate (P2P) counts test nodes that previously passed and still pass after the edits, measuring how well the model preserves existing functionality. We further split testing into two time points: process , the moment the user believes the current plan stage is done, capturing the actual completion state at that point; and final , a re-test after the session ends, which checks whether the model has fixed earlier mistakes by final delivery and how well it preserves existing functionality. These form three main metrics: Proc. F2P, the process-time F2P test-node pass rate; Final F2P, the final F2P test-node pass rate; and Final P2P, the final P2P test-node pass rate. For each model and persona, we pool passed and recorded test-node counts across instances, then equally average the four persona rates. Average is the arithmetic mean of these three metrics. As descriptors of interaction length and cost, we also report Turn/Session , the number of dialogue turns before the session ends, and Cost/Session , the estimated coding-assistant cost under the released fixed price schedule and cache model.
paragraphs.zh: 失败转通过率（F2P）统计的是先前失败但在编码助手修改后通过的测试节点，用于衡量模型完成所需功能的能力；通过转通过率（P2P）统计的是先前已通过且在修改后仍然通过的测试节点，用于衡量模型保留现有功能的能力。 我们将测试进一步划分为两个时间点：过程时刻，即用户认为当前计划阶段已完成时，记录此时的实际完成状态；以及最终时刻，即会话结束后重新进行测试，以检查模型是否通过最终交付修复了先前的错误，并评估其保留现有功能的能力。 这些构成了三个主要指标：Proc. F2P，即过程时刻的 F2P 测试节点通过率；最终 F2P，即最终的 F2P 测试节点通过率；以及最终 P2P，即最终的 P2P 测试节点通过率。 对于每个模型和角色，我们将各实例中通过并记录的测试节点数量汇总，然后对四个角色的比率取等权平均。 平均值是这三个指标的算术平均值。 作为交互长度和成本的描述指标，我们还报告了 Turn/Session（会话前的对话轮次数）和 Cost/Session（根据已发布的固定价格方案与缓存模型估算的编码助手成本）。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Journey comprises 30 long-horizon instances covering 594 subtasks, with 6,332 6{,}332 Fail-to-Pass (F2P) and 4,166 4{,}166 Pass-to-Pass (P2P) nodes after post-processing. Each instance is accompanied by a substantial reference patch that modifies, on average, 10.2 10.2 files and adds or removes 768.3 768.3 lines—approximately 2 × 2\times as many files and 4 × 4\times as many lines as SWE-bench Pro—highlighting the long-horizon nature of these tasks. Notably, our evaluation is relatively cost-efficient, averaging $56.64 per instance, including $12.47 in API fees and $44.17 in GPU rental costs for deploying GLM-5.2. This cost could be reduced further as models become more capable or through alternatives such as purchasing GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-Journey 包含 30 个长期规划实例，涵盖 594 个子任务；后处理完成后，共有 6,332 个“失败转通过”（F2P）节点和 4,166 个“通过转通过”（P2P）节点。 每个实例都附带一个较大的参考补丁，平均修改 10.2 个文件，并添加或删除 768.3 行代码——这一数字分别是 SWE-bench Pro 的两倍和四倍，凸显了这些任务的长期规划特性。 值得注意的是，我们的评估成本相对较低，平均每实例为 56.64 美元，其中包括 12.47 美元的 API 费用和部署 GLM-5.2 所需的 44.17 美元 GPU 租赁费用。 随着模型能力的提升，或通过购买 GPU 等替代方案，这一成本还可进一步降低。

paragraphs.en: To ensure benchmark correctness, we rely on three main layers of assurance. First, we perform online reliability checks, as described in the rubric discussion in § 3.2 . Second, we verify the benchmark after synthesis, checking the correctness of each test and the solvability of each subtask, aiming to ensure that all provided tests can pass and all tasks are solvable by models (Appendix A.4 ). Finally, we evaluate the comprehensiveness of the benchmark tasks (Appendix A.5 ), their authenticity, and the authenticity of interactions during testing (Appendix A.6 ). These evaluations demonstrate that the constructed tasks provide broad coverage, have practical relevance, and support realistic simulated interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保基准测试的正确性，我们依赖三个主要层次的保障机制。 首先，我们执行在线可靠性检查，具体如 § 3.2 中的评分标准讨论所述。 其次，我们在合成后验证基准测试，检查每个测试的正确性以及每个子任务的可解性，旨在确保所有提供的测试都能通过，且所有任务都能被模型解决（附录 A.4）。 最后，我们评估基准测试任务的全面性（附录 A.5）、其真实性，以及测试过程中交互的真实性（附录 A.6）。 这些评估表明，所构建的任务具有广泛的覆盖范围、实际相关性，并支持逼真的模拟交互。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate thirteen LLMs spanning a wide capability range on SWE-Journey . Following Yang et al. (2024) , we use mini-swe-agent as the evaluation harness for the coding assistant. To accommodate long-horizon tasks, we apply a minimal truncation strategy that prevents the interaction history from exceeding the model’s context window. Appendix B.1 details execution, truncation, and cost settings.

paragraphs.en: SWE-Journey combines sustained dialogue with repository development. Models average 18.28 18.28 turns per session, exceeding the 5.73 5.73 ( Shastry et al., 2026 ) , 5.44 5.44 ( Orlanski et al., 2026 ) , 8.73 8.73 ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , and 9.35 9.35 turns ( Raghavendra et al., 2026 ) reported by prior work; the Software Architect elicits 25.92 25.92 turns. The long horizon is also reflected in reference-patch scale: each instance averages 19.8 19.8 subtasks whose patches collectively touch 10.2 10.2 files and change 768.3 768.3 lines. These statistics separately capture interaction length and development scale, showing that the evaluation requires sustained, interdependent changes across files over multiple turns.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows low functional completion in long-horizon, multi-turn code assistance: all models score below 50 % 50\% on Proc. F2P, and the highest Final F2P is only 52.22 % 52.22\% . Nearly half of the functional tests remain unsatisfied, highlighting the challenge faced by current models. In terms of functionality retention, stronger models already maintain existing functionality well, with average scores above 90 % 90\% ; however, retention remains below 80 % 80\% for some models, indicating that weaker models still incur several regressions during long-horizon editing. Finally, Final F2P exceeds Proc. F2P for every model, by 3.53 3.53 percentage points on average. These net gains indicate some ability to correct mistakes during subsequent task execution, but remain insufficient to close the large functionality gap.

paragraphs.en: Performance varies substantially across collaboration conditions. Under the Software Architect, mean Final F2P reaches 78.50 % 78.50\% , and Claude-Opus-5 reaches 93.59 % 93.59\% , demonstrating that the models are capable of solving the underlying tasks. However, on the same instances, the Non-coder mean is only 23.00 % 23.00\% , a gap of 55.50 55.50 percentage points. This gap suggests that the low overall accuracy may be driven by differences in users’ interaction patterns rather than by limited problem-solving ability of the models themselves. It also indicates that current coding assistants are not yet capable of making programming accessible to non-programmers, and that the reliability of the code they produce still requires substantial improvement. As a reference, we also provide all requirements upfront in a single-shot setting to minimize the influence of interaction. For each of the eleven models covered by the comparison, single-shot Final F2P is below the highest persona result, Software Architect, but above the other three persona results (Appendix B.2 ), demonstrating that user interaction can either improve or degrade performance and that having experts operate coding assistants can yield reasonably reliable results.
paragraphs.zh: 不同协作条件下，性能存在显著差异。 在“软件架构师”条件下，最终 F2P 均值为 78.50 % 78.50\%，而 Claude-Opus-5 的均值为 93.59 % 93.59\%，这表明这些模型能够解决底层任务。 然而，在相同实例中，“非编码者”的均值仅为 23.00 % 23.00\%，两者相差 55.50 个百分点。 这一差距表明，较低的整体准确率可能源于用户交互模式的不同，而非模型本身解决问题能力的局限。 这也说明，当前的编码助手尚无法让非程序员轻松掌握编程，且其生成的代码可靠性仍需大幅提升。 作为参考，我们还在单次提示设置中提前提供所有需求，以尽量减少交互的影响。 在比较涵盖的十一个模型中，每个模型的单次提示最终 F2P 均低于最高的人设结果“软件架构师”，但高于其他三个人设的结果（附录 B.2），这表明用户交互既可能提升也可能降低性能，而由专家操作编码助手则能产生较为可靠的结果。

paragraphs.en: We further analyze why performance differs so substantially across user personas and models. We follow three consecutive interaction stages—eliciting requirements ( Asking Right ), locating the code to change ( Finding Right ), and implementing changes ( Fixing Right )—and identify characteristic failure modes at each, often associated with vague user requests. We quantify these behaviors in Table 3 . This analysis requires tracking evolving requirements and judging behavior against repository context; manual annotation is costly and expertise-intensive, so we use an LLM as a judge. Appendix B.3 gives the judgment rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步分析了为何不同用户角色和模型之间的性能存在如此显著的差异。 我们遵循三个连续的交互阶段——提出需求（正确提问）、定位需要修改的代码（正确查找）以及实施修改（正确修复）——并识别出每个阶段的典型失败模式，这些模式通常与模糊的用户请求相关。 我们在表 3 中量化了这些行为。 这项分析需要跟踪不断变化的需求，并根据代码库上下文对行为进行判断；手动标注既耗时又需要高度专业经验，因此我们使用一个大语言模型作为评判者。 附录 B.3 提供了评判规则。

paragraphs.en: A coding assistant must first recover the true task from a vague request. Non-coders cannot read code and may themselves be uncertain about their requirements: they often describe observed symptoms only vaguely and may occasionally issue mistaken or even destructive requests. Rather than executing such requests blindly, the model should clarify them until it has reliable requirements before editing. We measure Ask% , the share of interaction turns that solicit user input, and Rel% , the share of turns whose questions are relevant to the task’s main line. Most models currently ask relatively infrequently, with most soliciting input on fewer than 20 % 20\% of turns. Hy4-Preview and Claude-Opus-5 , by contrast, ask frequently, which helps them recover user intent and achieve higher test-node pass rates. The case in Appendix C.2 contrasts Claude-Opus-5 ’s targeted clarification of ambiguous requests with GPT-5.6-Sol ’s occasional direct implementation despite prompts to ask.
paragraphs.zh: 编程助手必须首先从模糊的请求中恢复真正的任务。 非程序员无法阅读代码，他们自己可能对需求也不确定：他们通常只能模糊地描述观察到的症状，偶尔甚至可能发出错误或具有破坏性的请求。 模型不应盲目执行此类请求，而应在编辑前不断澄清，直到获得可靠的需求。 我们测量 Ask%（交互回合中请求用户输入的占比）和 Rel%（问题与任务主线相关的回合占比）。 目前大多数模型提问的频率相对较低，其中多数模型在不到 20% 的回合中请求输入。 相比之下，Hy4-Preview 和 Claude-Opus-5 会频繁提问，这有助于它们恢复用户意图并实现更高的测试节点通过率。 附录 C.2 中的案例对比了 Claude-Opus-5 对模糊请求的针对性澄清，以及 GPT-5.6-Sol 在收到提问提示后仍偶尔直接执行操作的情况。

paragraphs.en: Once the task is established, the coding assistant must locate the code to change. Miss% measures the share of turns with off-target localization, namely turns in which the model fails to identify which part of the code the user wants changed. Alongside it, OC% measures the share of turns in which the model grows more confident in a wrong direction, for example by fabricating technical authority or citations to reject a correct user hint. Frontier models already lead on Miss, whereas the weakest models approach 60 % 60\% , indicating that incorrect code localization occurs in more than half of their turns. OC further shows that weaker, smaller models can be overconfident and stubborn, compounding incorrect edits and damaging existing functionality. Cases in Appendix C.3 show that weaker models may miss the load-bearing code and grow confident in a wrong locus after a passing self-test. By contrast, GPT-5.6-Sol tracks user revisions, preserves existing behavior, and attains a higher completion rate.
paragraphs.zh: 任务确定后，编码助手必须找到需要修改的代码。 Miss% 衡量偏离目标定位的回合比例，即模型未能识别用户希望修改代码中哪一部分的回合。 同时，OC% 衡量模型朝着错误方向愈发自信的回合比例，例如通过捏造技术权威或引用文献来拒绝用户的正确提示。 Frontier 模型在 Miss 指标上已处于领先地位，而最弱的模型则接近 60 % 60\%，表明它们超过一半的回合都存在错误的代码定位问题。 OC 还显示，较弱且规模较小的模型可能过度自信且固执，导致错误编辑不断累积并破坏现有功能。 附录 C.3 中的案例表明，较弱的模型可能会忽略承载核心功能的代码，并在通过自我测试后对错误的位置产生信心。 相比之下，GPT-5.6-Sol 能够跟踪用户的修改、保留现有行为，并实现了更高的完成率。

sents.zh: Frontier 模型在 Miss 指标上已处于领先地位，而最弱的模型则接近 60 % 60\%，表明它们超过一半的回合都存在错误的代码定位问题。

sents.en: OC further shows that weaker, smaller models can be overconfident and stubborn, compounding incorrect edits and damaging existing functionality.
sents.zh: OC 还显示，较弱且规模较小的模型可能过度自信且固执，导致错误编辑不断累积并破坏现有功能。

sents.en: Cases in Appendix C.3 show that weaker models may miss the load-bearing code and grow confident in a wrong locus after a passing self-test.
sents.zh: 附录 C.3 中的案例表明，较弱的模型可能会忽略承载核心功能的代码，并在通过自我测试后对错误的位置产生信心。

sents.en: By contrast, GPT-5.6-Sol tracks user revisions, preserves existing behavior, and attains a higher completion rate.
sents.zh: 相比之下，GPT-5.6-Sol 能够跟踪用户的修改、保留现有行为，并实现了更高的完成率。

paragraphs.en: Even after identifying a problem, weaker models may reassure themselves without evidence and leave it unaddressed. We measure the Ungrounded Skip Rate (Skip%) , the share of turns that dismiss a noticed problem without grounds, and the Critical Skip Rate (Crit%) , restricted to skipped problems that would break a task requirement. Assessing whether a model noticed a problem requires its reasoning trace; consequently, closed-source models are not analyzed here. The Qwen and DeepSeek families skip problems on 16 16 – 17 % 17\% of turns and critical problems on 13 13 – 14 % 14\% . Appendix C.4 shows that these models exhibit a self-defense tendency: they often rationalize why no change is needed and report overly optimistic or forceful conclusions to users, resulting in lower accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 即使识别出问题，较弱的模型也可能在没有证据的情况下自我安慰，并让问题得不到解决。 我们测量了“无依据跳过率”（Skip%），即在没有依据的情况下忽略已注意到问题的回合所占比例；以及“关键问题跳过率”（Crit%），仅针对那些会破坏任务要求的被跳过的问题。 评估模型是否注意到某个问题需要查看其推理过程；因此，闭源模型在此未被分析。 Qwen 和 DeepSeek 系列模型在 16%–17% 的回合中跳过了问题，在 13%–14% 的回合中跳过了关键问题。 附录 C.4 显示，这些模型表现出一种自我防御倾向：它们常常为无需改变提供合理化解释，并向用户报告过于乐观或强硬的结论，从而导致准确率下降。

paragraphs.en: Appendix B.4 breaks down model performance by persona and shows that both Finding Right and Fixing Right improve as the persona becomes more cooperative, suggesting that ambiguous requests create substantial difficulty for models along both dimensions. The persona with clearly stated requirements but limited coding knowledge elicits the fewest questions, because its requirements are clearer and it cannot answer code-level questions. Appendix B.5 examines the data-leakage problem caused by directly crawling code from GitHub, how models search for such code, and that our synthesis procedure can avoid this issue. Cases in Appendix C.5 provide case-based evidence for these observations.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 B.4 按角色分析了模型性能，并表明“正确发现”和“正确修复”两项能力都会随着角色变得更加合作而提升，这说明模棱两可的请求在两个维度上都给模型带来了显著困难。 那个要求明确但编码知识有限的角色引发的提问最少，因为其需求更清晰，且无法回答代码层面的问题。 附录 B.5 研究了直接从 GitHub 抓取代码所导致的数据泄露问题、模型搜索此类代码的方式，以及我们的合成流程如何能够避免这一问题。 附录 C.5 中的案例为这些观察结果提供了基于案例的证据。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-Journey , a benchmark for more realistically evaluating coding assistants under realistic long-horizon and multi-turn interaction settings. We achieve this by automatically synthesizing long-horizon coding tasks through a scalable weak-to-strong pipeline, and using data mining for persona modeling and user simulation in coding assistance. Experiments across diverse models show that current assistants still struggle with reliable task completion, particularly when interacting with users with limited technical expertise. Further analysis identifies three key capabilities for effective coding assistance: asking right, finding right, and fixing right. We hope SWE-Journey serves as a foundation for developing coding assistants and enabling more realistic and reliable evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SWE-Journey，这是一个基准测试，用于在更贴近现实的长期和多轮交互场景下，对编码助手进行更真实的评估。 我们通过一个可扩展的弱到强流水线自动合成长期编码任务，并利用数据挖掘技术实现角色建模和编码辅助中的用户模拟，从而实现了这一目标。 针对多种模型进行的实验表明，当前的编码助手在可靠完成任务方面仍存在困难，尤其是在与技术水平有限的用户交互时。 进一步的分析确定了高效编码辅助所需的三项关键能力：正确提问、正确查找和正确修复。 我们希望 SWE-Journey 能够为开发编码助手以及实现更真实、更可靠的评估提供基础。

sents.en: We introduce SWE-Journey , a benchmark for more realistically evaluating coding assistants under realistic long-horizon and multi-turn interaction settings.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 SWE-Journey，这是一个基准测试，用于在更贴近现实的长期和多轮交互场景下，对编码助手进行更真实的评估。

sents.en: We achieve this by automatically synthesizing long-horizon coding tasks through a scalable weak-to-strong pipeline, and using data mining for persona modeling and user simulation in coding assistance.
sents.zh: 我们通过一个可扩展的弱到强流水线自动合成长期编码任务，并利用数据挖掘技术实现角色建模和编码辅助中的用户模拟，从而实现了这一目标。

sents.en: Experiments across diverse models show that current assistants still struggle with reliable task completion, particularly when interacting with users with limited technical expertise.
sents.zh: 针对多种模型进行的实验表明，当前的编码助手在可靠完成任务方面仍存在困难，尤其是在与技术水平有限的用户交互时。

sents.en: Further analysis identifies three key capabilities for effective coding assistance: asking right, finding right, and fixing right.
sents.zh: 进一步的分析确定了高效编码辅助所需的三项关键能力：正确提问、正确查找和正确修复。

sents.en: We hope SWE-Journey serves as a foundation for developing coding assistants and enabling more realistic and reliable evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们希望 SWE-Journey 能够为开发编码助手以及实现更真实、更可靠的评估提供基础。

paragraphs.en: First, although SWE-Journey enables long-horizon interactive evaluation, its scale is constrained by high synthesis and evaluation costs—task synthesis and main experiments alone cost $16k, excluding pilot runs and analysis. Nevertheless, we open-source our full pipeline so anyone can synthesize custom data. Second, our user simulator only approximates real users via persona-conditioned generation. While grounded in real-world data, it cannot fully capture human complexity; rather than claiming perfect human-level realism, we push beyond prior work to approximate real user behavior more closely. Third, generated tasks may inherit biases from underlying repositories and synthesis models. Future work could combine diverse models for plan generation and introduce richer initial states to reduce repetition and further improve ecological validity.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，尽管 SWE-Journey 支持长时程的交互式评估，但其规模受到高昂的合成与评估成本的限制——仅任务合成和主要实验就花费了 16,000 美元，还不包括试点运行和分析费用。 尽管如此，我们还是将完整流程开源，以便任何人都可以合成自定义数据。 其次，我们的用户模拟器仅通过基于角色设定的人物生成来近似模拟真实用户。 虽然该模拟器以真实世界数据为基础，但无法完全捕捉人类的复杂性；我们并不声称其具有完美的人类级拟真性，而是超越先前的研究，力求更贴近真实用户行为。 第三，生成的任务可能会继承底层代码库和合成模型中的偏见。 未来的工作可以结合多种模型进行计划生成，并引入更丰富的初始状态，以减少重复性并进一步提升生态效度。

paragraphs.en: Data synthesis has also been explored. One line builds verifiable tasks from issues, commits, and pull requests ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Badertdinov et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , derives executable tasks and environments from tests and execution signals ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) , or synthesizes verifiable bug-fixing data ( Pham et al., 2025 ) . These methods provide executable supervision at scale, but reliance on public artifacts limits diversity and raises leakage risk. A second line creates tasks by injecting or synthesizing bugs into existing codebases ( Sonwane et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , extending this approach to skill-conditioned tasks and synthetic training environments ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . A third line removes the existing-implementation requirement by generating complete repositories from natural-language specifications ( Zan et al., 2024 ; Peng et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 数据合成方法也已被探索。 一类方法从问题、提交和拉取请求中构建可验证的任务（Pan 等，2024；Badertdinov 等，2025；Wang 等，2025），从测试和执行信号中推导出可执行的任务和环境（Jain 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025b），或合成可验证的修复缺陷数据（Pham 等，2025）。 这些方法能够大规模提供可执行的监督，但对公开产出的依赖限制了多样性并增加了信息泄露的风险。 第二类方法通过向现有代码库注入或合成缺陷来创建任务（Sonwane 等，2025；Wei 等，2025；Yang 等，2025b），并将这种方法扩展到基于技能的任务和合成训练环境（Xie 等，2026；Zhu 等，2025）。 第三类方法通过根据自然语言规范生成完整的代码库，消除了必须存在现有实现的要求（Zan 等，2024；Peng 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: However, existing methods mostly produce isolated bug-fixing tasks or one-shot repository construction rather than coherent long-horizon trajectories. Our weak-to-strong data-synthesis framework addresses this gap by generating follow-up requirements without copying public issues or their corresponding fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有方法大多只能生成孤立的缺陷修复任务或单次仓库构建，而非连贯的长期轨迹。 我们的弱到强数据合成框架通过生成后续需求来解决这一问题，而无需复制公开问题或相应的修复方案。

sents.en: Our weak-to-strong data-synthesis framework addresses this gap by generating follow-up requirements without copying public issues or their corresponding fixes.

paragraphs.en: We characterize tasks by context scope, change scope, requirement depth, and knowledge breadth, and use these dimensions to guide difficulty escalation in subsequent plans.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过上下文范围、变化范围、需求深度和知识广度来描述任务，并利用这些维度指导后续计划中的难度提升。

paragraphs.en: Context scope maps how much code a task must understand onto five ordered levels: no-context (natural language alone suffices; no code or logs needed), snippet (the provided task, code fragment, error, or diff excerpt suffices), single-file (requires understanding definitions, imports, and control flow within one complete file), multi-file (call relations across files or collaboration within one module), and repo (repository-level conventions, test harness, dependency management, or cross-module architecture).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文范围将一项任务需要理解多少代码映射到五个有序级别：无上下文（仅自然语言即可；无需代码或日志）、片段（所提供的任务、代码片段、错误信息或差异摘录即可）、单文件（需要理解单个完整文件内的定义、导入和控制流）、多文件（跨文件的调用关系或单个模块内的协作）以及仓库（仓库级别的惯例、测试框架、依赖管理或跨模块架构）。

paragraphs.en: Change scope maps how much a task must modify onto five ordered levels: no-change (explanation, analysis, or advice without editing artifacts), local (one logical unit: function, method, class, component, or config block), single-file (multiple units within one file or file-level restructuring), multi-file (several files in one module/package without changing cross-component contracts), and cross-component (cross-component logic or changes to a public API/CLI/schema/protocol).
paragraphs.zh: 变更范围将任务所需修改的程度划分为五个有序级别：无变更（对产物进行解释、分析或提供建议，但无需编辑）、局部（一个逻辑单元：函数、方法、类、组件或配置块）、单文件（单个文件内的多个单元或对文件级别的重新结构）、多文件（在一个模块/包内修改多个文件，但不改变跨组件契约），以及跨组件（跨组件逻辑或对公共 API/CLI/模式/协议的变更）。

paragraphs.en: Requirement depth captures the abstraction and type of requirements through multiple labels. The fixed labels are: explicit bug (a concrete bug naming a function, symptom, or error, with a narrow fix target), behavior adjustment (a semantic or edge-case correction without naming a file), feature addition (a new capability, typically preserving old behavior or a compatibility path), refactor or migration (replacing an internal mechanism, migrating an implementation, or restructuring without changing external behavior), and release or roadmap (a release-note-, roadmap-, or version-level requirement bundling multiple capabilities and constraints). A task can carry several labels, for example when adding a capability while correcting old behavior; the statistics in Appendix A.5 report the average label count per case.
paragraphs.zh: 需求深度通过多个标签来体现需求的抽象层次和类型。 固定的标签包括：明确缺陷（具体命名某个函数、症状或错误的缺陷，修复目标明确）、行为调整（语义或边界情况修正，但未指定文件）、功能添加（新增一项能力，通常保留原有行为或提供兼容路径）、重构或迁移（替换内部机制、迁移实现方式或在不改变外部行为的前提下进行结构重组），以及发布或路线图（以发布说明、路线图或版本为单位的需求，整合了多项能力和约束）。 一个任务可能包含多个标签，例如在添加新功能的同时修正原有行为；附录 A.5 中的统计数据报告了每个案例的平均标签数量。

sents.en: Requirement depth captures the abstraction and type of requirements through multiple labels.
sents.zh: 需求深度通过多个标签来体现需求的抽象层次和类型。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge breadth characterizes the distinct knowledge domains involved in an individual task, counted using the taxonomy in Table 4 (e.g., ORM/data-access, concurrency, serialization). This radar axis is labeled Knowledge domains ; dataset-level knowledge-domain coverage instead measures the domains covered by the task collection relative to the source pool.
paragraphs.zh: 知识广度用于描述单个任务所涉及的独特知识领域，其计数依据表 4 中的分类体系（例如：ORM/数据访问、并发、序列化）。 该雷达轴标注为“知识领域”；而数据集层级的知识领域覆盖范围则用于衡量任务集合相对于源池所涵盖的知识领域。

paragraphs.en: Of the four dimensions above, Knowledge breadth lacks explicit category definitions. In addition, we introduce a new task angle to diversify generated tasks. We therefore construct taxonomies for both. Both taxonomies follow the main text’s persona-dimension extraction procedure (§ 3.3 ): an LLM labels each SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro instance; embeddings and capacity-constrained k k -means form balanced clusters; an LLM deduplicates near-identical labels; dimensions are then extracted and human-confirmed. For the knowledge-domain taxonomy, its categories fall under Core Task, Task Domain, Programming Language, and Input Modality, capturing what the model does, where the task occurs, which ecosystem it uses, and what input it handles. The same procedure yields a 20-category task-angle synthesis pool. Both taxonomies derive from benchmark content rather than manual authoring, giving a source-grounded basis for measuring coverage against the source pool.
paragraphs.zh: 在上述四个维度中，“知识广度”缺乏明确的类别定义。 此外，我们引入了一种新的任务角度，以丰富生成的任务多样性。 因此，我们为这两者构建了分类体系。 这两种分类体系均遵循正文中的人物-维度提取流程（§ 3.3）：首先由一个大语言模型对每个 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 实例进行标注；接着通过嵌入表示和容量受限的 k-k 均值算法形成均衡的聚类；再由大语言模型去除近乎相同的标签；最后提取出维度并由人工确认。 对于知识领域分类体系，其类别涵盖核心任务、任务领域、编程语言和输入模态，分别对应模型执行的操作、任务发生的场景、所使用的生态系统以及处理的输入类型。 通过相同流程，我们得到了一个包含 20 个类别的任务角度合成池。 这两种分类体系均源自基准数据集的内容，而非人工编写，从而为基于源数据集评估覆盖范围提供了可靠依据。

paragraphs.en: Guided by these taxonomies, we promote coverage during construction rather than only measuring it afterward. First, seed-task selection supports knowledge-domain coverage : greedy set-cover selects 30 instances from the merged SWE-bench Verified + SWE-bench Pro pool, each maximizing newly covered labels. Ties favor rarer labels via ∑ 1 / frequency \sum 1/\text{frequency} , and a three-instance cap per repository prevents popular repositories and domains from crowding out the tail. Second, planning-stage angle sampling broadens task-angle coverage : the implemented sampler uses a frozen 20-angle distribution. Before temperature-2 softmax, its defect-fixing entry is explicitly capped from 61.7 % 61.7\% to 19.7 % 19.7\% ; the two rarest angles are then floored and the weights renormalized to 100 % 100\% . Each instance samples four candidate angles for its plan prompt; the planner selects one or more as the main direction.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些分类体系的指导下，我们在构建过程中注重覆盖范围，而不仅仅是事后进行衡量。 首先，种子任务的选择支持知识领域的覆盖：贪心集合覆盖方法从合并后的 SWE-bench Verified + SWE-bench Pro 池中选出 30 个实例，每个实例都能最大化新增的覆盖标签。 在出现平局时，通过 ∑ 1 / frequency \sum 1/\text{frequency} 优先选择更稀有的标签；同时，每个仓库最多只能有三个实例，以防止热门仓库和领域挤占尾部样本。 其次，规划阶段的视角采样扩展了任务视角的覆盖范围：所采用的采样器使用一个固定的 20 个视角的分布。 在温度-2 softmax 之前，其缺陷修复相关的视角比例被明确地从 61.7 % 61.7\% 限制到 19.7 % 19.7\%；随后两个最稀有的视角会被设置下限，并将权重重新归一化为 100 % 100\%。 每个实例都会为其规划提示采样四个候选视角；规划器则会从中选择一个或多个作为主要方向。

paragraphs.en: The dataset-characterization scores in this section use one per-sample setup; the coding assistant-behavior judges described later use a separate model. For each (sample, dimension) pair, a fixed GLM-5.2 judge at temperature 0 0 reads the sample and dimension-specific prompt, then returns single- or multi-label annotations or a 1–5 score with rationale, avoiding judge differences in cross-source comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 本节中的数据集特征描述分数采用每样本一个的设置；后文描述的编码助手行为评估则使用独立的模型。 对于每个（样本，维度）对，一个在温度为 0 时固定的 GLM-5.2 评估器会读取该样本和维度特定的提示，然后返回单标签或多标签标注，或附带理由的 1–5 分评分，从而避免跨来源比较时因评估器不同而产生的差异。

paragraphs.en: To preserve broad engineering coverage without inheriting the source benchmarks’ bias toward frequent bug-fixing tasks, seed selection targets knowledge-domain coverage. After seed selection, an LLM-as-a-judge measures the source-pool knowledge coverage retained by the synthesized cases. Table 4 reports each attested domain’s prevalence in the sources and the 30 synthesized cases, omitting domains absent from all datasets. All columns use multi-label counting and need not sum to 100 % 100\% . The 30 synthesized cases cover 48 of the 56 domains attested across the source benchmarks ( 85.7 % 85.7\% ), preserving most technical coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在保留广泛工程覆盖范围的同时，避免继承源基准测试中对频繁修复漏洞任务的偏见，种子选择以知识领域的覆盖为目标。 种子选择之后，一个作为评判者的 LLM 会衡量合成案例所保留的源池知识覆盖范围。 表 4 报告了每个已验证领域在源数据和 30 个合成案例中的出现频率，并省略了在所有数据集中均未出现的领域。 所有列均使用多标签计数，其总和不必等于 100 % 100\% 。 这 30 个合成案例覆盖了源基准测试中全部 56 个已验证领域的 48 个（85.7 % 85.7\% ），从而保留了大部分技术覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: To broaden generation beyond bug fixing, we use planning-stage angle sampling. Table 5 reports source angle distributions (multi-label) and the final mix for the 30 synthesized cases under the canonical 20-angle taxonomy. The resulting mix extends beyond bug fixing to feature addition, interface-contract adjustment, data processing, and observability. The New task angles axis in Appendix A.5 counts distinct angles per case from this taxonomy (e.g., bug fixing, feature addition, refactoring, security governance); its Ours value is the corresponding mean of 3.80 3.80 angles per case. Our synthesized cases cover all task-angle categories except Environment setup and Repository collaboration ; these two categories are outside our primary focus.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将生成范围从修复缺陷扩展到更广泛的领域，我们采用了规划阶段的视角采样方法。 表 5 报告了源视角的分布（多标签）以及根据标准 20 视角分类法合成的 30 个案例的最终混合结果。 由此产生的混合结果不仅涵盖了修复缺陷，还包括功能添加、接口合同调整、数据处理和可观察性。 附录 A.5 中的“新任务视角”轴统计了该分类法中每个案例的不同视角数量（例如：修复缺陷、功能添加、重构、安全治理）；其“我们的”值是每个案例对应的平均视角数，为 3.80。 我们合成的案例涵盖了除“环境设置”和“仓库协作”之外的所有任务视角类别；这两个类别不在我们的主要研究范围内。

paragraphs.en: Simulated users must differ in interaction behavior, not merely wording. We define five user-side dimensions and categories in Table 6 . They constrain knowledge boundary, expression preference, process control, goal evolution, and verification while keeping hidden task facts unchanged, forming a controlled space for realistic simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟用户必须在互动行为上存在差异，而不仅仅是措辞不同。 我们在表 6 中定义了五个用户侧的维度和类别。 它们在保持隐藏任务事实不变的同时，对知识边界、表达偏好、流程控制、目标演变和验证进行了约束，从而构建了一个用于真实模拟的受控空间。

paragraphs.en: The persona taxonomy should reflect real coding-assistant users, not arbitrary roles. We group the Log subset with all five dimensions available by user expertise (D1) into four representative personas. Table 8 reports how each persona’s D2–D5 behavior deviates from the overall Log population, with each multiplier equal to within-group frequency divided by overall frequency. The profiles show distinct tendencies: Product Managers favor hands-off control with little systematic verification; New Developers show more hands-on control and single checks; Software Architects favor align-first or checkpointed control, structured or detailed exchanges, and systematic verification. The Non-coder group has 27 27 instances and is reported for completeness. These profiles inform the settings below.
paragraphs.zh: 角色分类应反映真实的编码助手用户，而非随意设定的角色。 我们将 Log 子集与所有五个维度（按用户专业水平 D1 划分）组合，归纳为四个代表性角色。 表 8 报告了每个角色的 D2–D5 行为与整体 Log 群体之间的偏离情况，其中每个乘数等于组内频率除以总体频率。 这些特征显示出明显倾向：产品经理偏好低干预控制且几乎无系统性验证；新开发者则表现出更多主动干预控制和单次检查；软件架构师则偏好“先对齐”或带检查点的控制方式、结构化或详细的交流，以及系统性验证。 非编码者群体包含 27 个实例，此处为保持完整而一并报告。 这些特征为以下设置提供了依据。

sents.en: The persona taxonomy should reflect real coding-assistant users, not arbitrary roles.
sents.zh: 角色分类应反映真实的编码助手用户，而非随意设定的角色。

sents.en: We group the Log subset with all five dimensions available by user expertise (D1) into four representative personas.
sents.zh: 我们将 Log 子集与所有五个维度（按用户专业水平 D1 划分）组合，归纳为四个代表性角色。

sents.en: Table 8 reports how each persona’s D2–D5 behavior deviates from the overall Log population, with each multiplier equal to within-group frequency divided by overall frequency.
sents.zh: 表 8 报告了每个角色的 D2–D5 行为与整体 Log 群体之间的偏离情况，其中每个乘数等于组内频率除以总体频率。

sents.en: The profiles show distinct tendencies: Product Managers favor hands-off control with little systematic verification; New Developers show more hands-on control and single checks; Software Architects favor align-first or checkpointed control, structured or detailed exchanges, and systematic verification.
sents.zh: 这些特征显示出明显倾向：产品经理偏好低干预控制且几乎无系统性验证；新开发者则表现出更多主动干预控制和单次检查；软件架构师则偏好“先对齐”或带检查点的控制方式、结构化或详细的交流，以及系统性验证。

sents.en: The Non-coder group has 27 27 instances and is reported for completeness.
sents.zh: 非编码者群体包含 27 个实例，此处为保持完整而一并报告。

sents.en: These profiles inform the settings below.
sents.zh: 这些特征为以下设置提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark needs a small set of interpretable user types that stress different interaction modes. We instantiate four simulated users across the five-dimensional taxonomy in Table 7 , taking each dimension’s highest relative-frequency multiplier as a starting point (not the most frequent category within that group). However, applied directly, this rule makes the Non-coder and Product Manager highly similar in hands-off control, stable goals, and no user verification, duplicating closely related collaboration conditions. To broaden coverage, we retain stable goals for the Product Manager and adjust the Non-coder’s Goal Stability to its second-highest-multiplier choice, pivoting . This creates a less cooperative non-technical user condition: the user may confidently suggest an incorrect direction and later revise the request, while providing neither code-level guidance nor independent implementation checks. The adjustment is intended to assess the coding assistant’s robustness to these more demanding interactions. The configurations span Non-coders, Product Managers, New Developers, and Software Architects, exposing the same benchmark instance to different knowledge boundaries, control styles, and validation behaviors. These data-informed profiles prioritize coverage of distinct collaboration conditions; they are not intended to reproduce the behavioral frequencies or joint distribution of the corresponding real-world user populations. The unit of comparison is this complete collaboration condition, rather than an intervention on any single dimension; the persona results therefore do not identify the separate contributions of expertise, information, or feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试需要一组规模较小但具有可解释性的用户类型，这些类型能够针对不同的交互模式施加压力。 我们在表 7 的五维分类体系中实例化了四个模拟用户，以每个维度中相对频率乘数最高的值作为起点（而非该组中最频繁的分类）。 然而，若直接应用此规则，则“非编码者”和“产品经理”在无需干预的控制方式、稳定的目标以及缺乏用户验证方面会高度相似，从而重复了彼此密切相关的协作条件。 为扩大覆盖范围，我们保留了“产品经理”的稳定目标，并将“非编码者”的目标稳定性调整为其乘数第二高的选项，从而实现转向。 由此产生了一种合作性较弱的非技术用户情境：该用户可能自信地提出错误方向的建议，并在后续修改请求，但既不提供代码层面的指导，也不进行独立的实现验证。 这一调整旨在评估编码助手在面对这些更具挑战性的交互时的稳健性。 这些配置涵盖了“非编码者”“产品经理”“新开发者”和“软件架构师”，使同一基准测试实例暴露于不同的知识边界、控制风格和验证行为之下。 这些基于数据的用户画像优先覆盖不同的协作条件，而非意图再现对应现实用户群体的行为频率或联合分布。 比较的基本单位是完整的协作条件，而非对任何单一维度的干预；因此，人物设定结果无法识别专业知识、信息或反馈各自的独立贡献。

paragraphs.en: Non-coder. A user with no coding ability who typically speaks in symptoms, desired behaviors, and business outcomes rather than code, files, or interfaces. Their goal is unstable: they may start with a confidently wrong high-level direction and correct it after seeing the result ( pivoting ), but cannot catch implementation errors. This persona stresses extracting an actionable specification from non-technical, shifting requests without technical guidance or checking.
paragraphs.zh: 非编码者。 一名不具备编码能力的用户，通常用症状、期望行为和业务成果来描述需求，而不是用代码、文件或接口。 他们的目标并不稳定：他们可能会先给出一个自信但错误的高层方向，在看到结果后进行调整（转向），但却无法发现实现过程中的错误。 这一角色强调在缺乏技术指导或验证的情况下，从非技术性的、不断变化的需求中提取出可执行的具体规范。

sents.zh: 非编码者。

paragraphs.en: Product manager. A product or business owner who frames requests as feature goals and user-facing results rather than implementation. Their goal is stable and set upfront ( stable goal ). This persona stresses translating stable, high-level product intent into correct code with minimal input and no user-side checking.
paragraphs.zh: 产品负责人。 一位将需求定义为功能目标和面向用户的结果，而非具体实现的产品或业务负责人。 他们的目标是稳定且预先确定的（稳定目标）。 这一角色强调将稳定、高级的产品意图转化为正确的代码，同时输入最少且无需用户端验证。

sents.en: Product manager.
sents.zh: 产品负责人。

paragraphs.en: New Developer. An engineer who can read and reason about code but is new to the repository. They steer step by step at the level of modules, files, and local behavior. Their goal may pivot as they learn the codebase; like the Non-coder, they may start with a confidently wrong direction and revise it when evidence contradicts it. This persona stresses collaboration with an actively steering but repository-unfamiliar developer whose direction can change mid-task.
paragraphs.zh: 新开发者。 能够阅读并理解代码，但对代码库尚不熟悉的一名工程师。 他们以模块、文件和局部行为为单位，逐步推进操作。 随着对代码库的了解加深，他们的目标可能会发生转变；与“非编码者”类似，他们最初可能自信地选择错误方向，并在有证据表明该方向有误时进行调整。 这一角色强调与一位积极主导但尚不熟悉代码库的开发者进行协作，而该开发者的方向可能在任务中途发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Software Architect. A software architect and maintainer who guards architecture and compatibility constraints. They align before execution and review key checkpoints. Their goal is stable in intent but elaborated as architectural implications surface ( evolving ). They verify systematically with checks and concrete evidence. This persona stresses satisfying an expert who enforces architectural boundaries and rigorous validation.
paragraphs.zh: 软件架构师。 一位负责守护架构和兼容性约束的软件架构师与维护者。 他们在执行前进行对齐，并审查关键检查点。 他们的目标在意图上是稳定的，但随着架构影响的显现而不断细化（动态演进）。 他们通过检查和具体证据进行系统性验证。 这一角色强调满足一位会强制执行架构边界和严格验证的专家需求。

sents.zh: 软件架构师。

paragraphs.en: We verify that tasks remain solvable , so failures reflect model capability rather than ill-posed or infeasible subtasks. Because subtasks form a dependent chain, our subtask solvability check first applies all preceding reference patches—a reference prefix —then lets the model attempt only the current incremental change, isolating solvability from earlier failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们验证任务仍然可解，因此失败反映的是模型能力问题，而非子任务设定不当或不可行。 由于子任务构成一个依赖链，我们的子任务可解性检查首先应用所有前置参考补丁——即一个参考前缀——然后仅让模型尝试当前的增量变化，从而将可解性与早期失败隔离开来。

sents.en: We verify that tasks remain solvable , so failures reflect model capability rather than ill-posed or infeasible subtasks.
sents.zh: 我们验证任务仍然可解，因此失败反映的是模型能力问题，而非子任务设定不当或不可行。

sents.en: Because subtasks form a dependent chain, our subtask solvability check first applies all preceding reference patches—a reference prefix —then lets the model attempt only the current incremental change, isolating solvability from earlier failures.
sents.zh: 由于子任务构成一个依赖链，我们的子任务可解性检查首先应用所有前置参考补丁——即一个参考前缀——然后仅让模型尝试当前的增量变化，从而将可解性与早期失败隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: We check all subtasks with a two-stage cascade: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is the primary model and GLM 5.2 is the fallback, with at most four attempts per model stage and early stopping once the subtask’s F2P and P2P tests both pass. The stored machine state records 77.7 % 77.7\% subtasks with a passing run. A subsequent manual audit identified 8.2 % 8.2\% initially unsolved subtasks as under-specified and revised exactly those query/acceptance pairs in natural language without exposing test names, assertions, file paths, or F2P entries. The remaining 14.1 % 14.1\% failures are attributed to model limitations and left their requirements unchanged. To further assess whether these initially unsolved subtasks were solvable after the review, we examined the subsequent interactive evaluation. Among the previously unsolved subtasks covered by the experiments, all had at least one successful run under the Software Architect persona, and 93.33 % 93.33\% were successfully completed by at least three distinct coding-assistant models. These results further support the solvability of these subtasks under expert-guided interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个两阶段级联流程检查所有子任务：DeepSeek-V4-Flash 是主模型，GLM 5.2 是备用模型，每个模型阶段最多尝试四次，一旦子任务的 F2P 和 P2P 测试均通过，则提前停止。 存储的机器状态记录了 77.7 % 77.7\% 的子任务有成功运行的记录。 随后的手动审计发现，最初未解决的 8.2 % 8.2\% 子任务因定义不足所致，并仅针对这些查询/接受对的自然语言描述进行了修订，未暴露测试名称、断言、文件路径或 F2P 条目。 其余 14.1 % 14.1\% 的失败归因于模型局限性，其需求保持不变。 为了进一步评估这些最初未解决的子任务在审查后是否可解决，我们检查了后续的交互式评估。 在实验涵盖的先前未解决的子任务中，所有子任务在软件架构师角色下至少有一次成功运行，且 93.33 % 93.33\% 的子任务由至少三个不同的编码助手模型成功完成。 这些结果进一步支持了这些子任务在专家引导的交互下具有可解决性。

paragraphs.en: Because F2P and P2P test nodes are generated for individual subtasks, their original classification may not remain valid when evaluating the complete task chain. We therefore reassign the test nodes for whole-task evaluation. We first exclude nodes that fail or cannot be collected after all reference patches are applied, removing them from both numerators and denominators. Among the remaining nodes, declared P2P nodes that do not pass on the base-commit-plus-seed-patch baseline are reclassified as F2P; the other P2P nodes remain regression checks. The resulting classification across the generated benchmark contains 6,332 6{,}332 F2P and 4,166 4{,}166 P2P nodes ( 10,498 10{,}498 in total).
paragraphs.zh: 由于 F2P 和 P2P 测试节点是为单个子任务生成的，因此在评估完整任务链时，它们的原始分类可能不再有效。 因此，我们对整个任务的测试节点进行重新分配。 我们首先排除所有参考补丁应用后失败或无法收集的节点，并将这些节点从分子和分母中同时移除。 在剩余的节点中，那些在“基础提交加种子补丁”基线上未通过测试的已声明 P2P 节点被重新分类为 F2P；其他 P2P 节点则仍作为回归检查保留。 由此生成的基准测试中的最终分类包含 6,332 个 F2P 节点和 4,166 个 P2P 节点（总计 10,498 个）。

sents.en: The resulting classification across the generated benchmark contains 6,332 6{,}332 F2P and 4,166 4{,}166 P2P nodes ( 10,498 10{,}498 in total).
sents.zh: 由此生成的基准测试中的最终分类包含 6,332 个 F2P 节点和 4,166 个 P2P 节点（总计 10,498 个）。

paragraphs.en: We increase task difficulty round by round and verify two further aspects: (iii) task scale —reference patches touch 10.2 10.2 files and change 768.3 768.3 lines per instance, roughly 8 × 8\times the files and over 50 × 50\times the lines of SWE-bench Verified, and 2 × 2\times the files and over 4 × 4\times the lines of SWE-bench Pro; and (iv) coverage and composition —the five-axis radar in Figure 3 shows that SWE-Journey broadly envelops existing benchmarks, indicating joint gains in long-horizon difficulty and compositional coverage along the intended axes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们逐轮增加任务难度，并验证另外两个方面：(iii) 任务规模——参考代码片段涉及 10.2 个文件和每实例 768.3 行代码，大约是 SWE-bench Verified 中文件数量的 8 × 8 倍和代码行数的 50 × 50 倍以上，也分别是 SWE-bench Pro 中文件数量的 2 × 2 倍和代码行数的 4 × 4 倍以上；以及 (iv) 覆盖范围与组合性——图 3 中的五轴雷达图显示，SWE-Journey 在整体上涵盖了现有基准测试，表明其在预期维度上同时提升了长期任务难度和组合性覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: Reference-patch size measures long-horizon scale. Rather than use self-reported figures, we recompute files touched and lines changed from all public reference patches under one convention: files from diff --git headers, excluding paired test patches; changed lines as additions plus deletions, excluding +++ / --- headers. Table 9 shows 10.2 10.2 files and 768.3 768.3 changed lines per instance: roughly 8 × 8\times the files and over 50 × 50\times the lines of SWE-bench Verified ( 1.25 1.25 files, 14 14 lines), and beyond SWE-bench Pro ( 5.07 5.07 files, 170 170 lines). Only SWE-EVO touches more files ( 21.1 21.1 ), while changed-line counts are comparable. Thus our subtasks remain focused yet combine into release-scale long-horizon updates.
paragraphs.zh: 参考补丁的大小衡量了长期更新的规模。 我们并未使用自我报告的数字，而是根据统一的标准，重新计算了所有公开参考补丁中涉及的文件和修改的行数：文件数据来自 diff --git 标题，不包含配对的测试补丁；修改行数则包括新增和删除行数，但不包含 +++ / --- 标题部分。 表9显示，每个实例涉及10.2个文件和768.3行修改：这大约是SWE-bench Verified（1.25个文件、14行）的8倍文件和超过50倍行数，也超过了SWE-bench Pro（5.07个文件、170行）。 只有SWE-EVO涉及的文件更多（21.1个），而修改行数的规模则相当接近。 因此，我们的子任务仍然保持专注，但综合起来仍能覆盖发布级别的长期更新。

sents.en: Reference-patch size measures long-horizon scale.
sents.zh: 参考补丁的大小衡量了长期更新的规模。

paragraphs.en: We verify that synthesis jointly increases long-horizon difficulty and compositional coverage along the intended axes. Figure 3 uses the four task dimensions defined in Appendix A.2 , together with new task angles, for a total of five axes normalized by cross-dataset maxima; SWE-Journey is starred with raw values annotated. Specifically, SWE-Journey scores 4.20 4.20 on context scope and 4.77 4.77 on change scope, averages 3.00 3.00 requirement labels per case for requirement depth, averages 8.70 8.70 distinct domains per case for knowledge breadth (labeled Knowledge domains in the figure), and averages 3.80 3.80 distinct angles per case for new task angles. The percentages in Table 5 and this mean use the same canonical 20-angle taxonomy, while the former gives category prevalence and the latter counts distinct labels per case. SWE-Journey leads on change scope, requirement depth, and new task angles, and is comparable to the strongest source on context scope and knowledge breadth. Its dataset-level breadth remains comparable to large source benchmarks despite the compact 30-instance synthesized set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们验证了联合合成能够沿着预期轴向同时提升长期难度和组合覆盖度。 图 3 使用了附录 A.2 中定义的四项任务维度，并结合新的任务角度，共形成五个通过跨数据集最大值归一化的轴；SWE-Journey 以星号标注，并附有原始值注释。 具体而言，SWE-Journey 在上下文范围上的得分为 4.20 4.20，在变更范围上的得分为 4.77 4.77，每个案例的平均需求标签数为 3.00 3.00（体现需求深度），每个案例的平均不同领域数为 8.70 8.70（体现知识广度，图中标注为“知识领域”），以及每个案例的平均不同任务角度数为 3.80 3.80（体现新任务角度）。 表 5 中的百分比和本处的平均值均使用相同的标准 20 角度分类体系，前者表示各类别的出现频率，后者则统计每个案例中不同的标签数量。 SWE-Journey 在变更范围、需求深度和新任务角度方面表现领先，在上下文范围和知识广度方面则与最强的基准模型相当。 尽管合成数据集仅包含 30 个实例，其数据集层面的广度仍与大型基准模型相当。

sents.zh: SWE-Journey 在变更范围、需求深度和新任务角度方面表现领先，在上下文范围和知识广度方面则与最强的基准模型相当。

sents.en: Its dataset-level breadth remains comparable to large source benchmarks despite the compact 30-instance synthesized set.
